name: Youth Council, Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts
org: Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts (PAFA)
what_you_do: Meet weekly after school at PAFA to make art and talk about it. You plan events for teens at the museum, work with staff and help with a teen art magazine.
pay_detail: Free to join. No pay or stipend is stated.
duration: Fall 2026: Wednesdays Oct 21 to Dec 9, 4 to 6 pm. Spring 2027: Wednesdays Jan 27 to Apr 14, 4 to 6 pm.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 started Oct 21, 2026; Spring 2027 starts Jan 27, 2027. The pages disagree: the PAFA page shows Register links, but as of Nov 4, 2026 the sign-up pages say both sessions are full. Spring has a wait list.
how_to_apply: Use the Register link on the Youth Council page, which goes to pafa-museum.coursestorm.com. Each session has its own Register link. As of Nov 4, 2026, both show as full. You can add your name to the Spring wait list.
notes: PAFA is on North Broad Street. The sign-up pages list ages 14 to 18 and grades 9 to 12. Ask PAFA if a spot opens.
